title: FDR on financial interests owning America

tellings.quote: And he he said to in a in a conversation or letter that he wrote that the financial interests had owned America since the time of Andrew Jackson.

plain: Franklin Roosevelt is said to have written or said, sometime in the 1930s, that financial interests had owned America since the days of President Andrew Jackson. The researcher Jason Simosa brings this up with Michels, saying it was "a conversation or letter" but naming neither one. He uses it to argue that hidden money and power have shaped the country for a long time.
